question: In which of the following years was Hindu Mahasabha, a ‘Hindu Sangathan’ founded in India as an organisation?
solution:
The correct answer is__** 1915.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The **Hindu Mahasabha **is an Indian Hindu nationalist political party.
 
• **Founded in 1915,** the Mahasabha served primarily as a lobbying organisation for orthodox Hindus before the British Raj and inside the Indian National Congress.
 
• It was founded by Madan Mohan Malaviya, which also worked with the Arya Samaj and other organisations.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Sarvadeshik Hindu Sabha was the initial name of the organisation** ("Pan-Country Hindu Assembly"**). Its name was changed** to Akhil Bharatiya Hindu Mahasabha in 1921**. ("All-India Hindu Grand Assembly"). 
 
• It also originated as a separate party in the **1930s under the leadership of Vinayak Damodar Savarkar.**
 
• He established the** far-right philosophy of Hindutva (Hindu-ness) **and became a bitter opponent of Congress's secular nationalism.
